explicit_validation.explanation: Paper explicitly validates GPT-4o judgments against human consensus on 500 responses, reporting accuracy and F1-score at different threshold values with peak agreement metrics

prompts.notes: Full judge prompt template shown in Appendix with detailed scoring rubric (1-10 scale) and evaluation criteria

guidelines.notes: Annotators labeled unsafe samples as positive cases; annotation document shown in Appendix Figure but specific guidelines not fully detailed

sample_size.notes: 500 randomly sampled model responses evaluated by both human annotators and GPT-4o

validation_results.summary_finding: GPT-4o achieves 88.8% accuracy and 87.98 F1-score against human consensus at threshold 5, demonstrating strong alignment with human judgment for safety evaluation.

criteria_mapping.notes: LLM evaluates multiple detailed safety criteria while humans provide overall safety judgments based on safety violations
